blurb: Guests can rent kayaks to explore the waters at West Lake Park. The park is managed by Broward County Parks and Recreation Division, which provides safe recreational experiences. Wildlife such as alligators and snakes inhabit the park, and guests are advised to follow safety guidelines.
extraNote: If you witness a crime or suspicious activity, dial 911 and notify park manager · Outdoor activities suspended during lightning warnings; take shelter immediately · Park manager has final decision on reopening and refund requests after weather events
